shared_elements: outstretched wing(s) rendered with rows of feathers
plant/floral motif (rosette-like elements in B; disc in A)
justification: Both surfaces depict profile human figures in low relief with prominently feathered wings rendered as ordered rows of overlapping plumes, and both include a figure whose arm is raised holding an object. But A is a multi-register composition dominated by rows of small figures and many lines of script beneath a winged disc spanning the top, whereas B is a single large-scale winged anthropomorphic figure beside a stylised plant with rosette-like blossoms, with no register divisions or inscription; the arrangements and the specific figural conventions (bulky bearded figure with horned headdress vs. slender schematic figures) differ substantially.
